[[File:SixYears.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The painting, ''Six Years of Galaxies'']]
'''''Six Years of Galaxies''''' was a painting depicting [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] head, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielding [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and some [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] attacking what appeared to be the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]].

==Description==
The painting included some text in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]], including ''Star Wars''&mdash;the title of what was being commemorated&mdash;as well as a list of ambiguous names, possibly [[entertainer]]s within the saga being noted. The painting seemed to speculate that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] would one day "return." This was quite ominous, given that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] did in fact return following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], years after the painting was created.

==History==
One of many paintings and other pieces of art available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], ''Five Years of Galaxies'' was most prevalent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It appeared some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and was a pivotal conflict in the war. Leia and Vader issued these paintings, alongside ''[[Five Years of Galaxies]]'' and various medals, during the festivities of [[Remembrance Day]] and [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]], respectively.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWG6thanniversary.jpg|thumb|120px|6 year anniversary logo.]]
This painting was only given out to players for the sixth year anniversary of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] live event of [[2009]].

This painting is actually the theatrical poster for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], a [[1983]] movie made by [[George Lucas]] as the sixth and final chronological installment of ''Star Wars''.

Unlike most of the other theatrical posters in the game, ''Six Years of Galaxies'' is not named after its movie counterpart, ''Return of the Jedi.''
